## Example 3.10 {#iv3-example-3-10 .vector-lesson .component-lesson .position-lesson}

If the vector $\begin{bmatrix}-3\\5\end{bmatrix}$ has an initial point at $(2,3)$, determine the coordinates of the end point.

<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Example 3.10 · p. 24</div>

::: notes
Endpoint=(-1,8). Add the displacement to the starting coordinates: (2,3)+(-3,5)=(-1,8). The initial point is not the origin. Complete the working in OneNote: move three units left and five units up from the given initial point. Reinforce B=A+AB, the rearrangement of AB=B−A.
:::
